subject: general
question: Which group of Indian islands lies in the Arabian Sea near the Malabar Coast and consists of coral islands?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshadweep Islands**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Lakshadweep Islands** are a group of 36 small coral islands located in the **Arabian Sea**, off the **Malabar Coast** of Kerala, India.
 
• These islands are known for their **coral reefs** and are the only **coral atolls** in India.
 
• The name "Lakshadweep" means "**One hundred thousand islands**" in Sanskrit.
 
• The islands are formed by **coral deposits** and are home to a rich biodiversity, including various species of **marine life, coral, and flora.**
 
• The **capital** of Lakshadweep is **Kavaratti**, which is also one of the most prominent islands in the group.
 
• It is a **Union Territory** of India, administered directly by the Central Government.
 
• The islands are known for their serene beaches, lagoons, and natural beauty, making them a popular tourist destination.
 
• The economy of Lakshadweep heavily depends on **fishing, coconut cultivation, and tourism.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Andaman Islands**__

 __
 
• The **Andaman Islands** are located in the **Bay of Bengal**, not the Arabian Sea.
 
• They are known for their tropical rainforests, diverse ecosystems, and indigenous tribes.
 
• The Andaman Islands are part of the larger **Andaman and Nicobar Islands Union Territory**.
 
 
 
• **Nicobar Islands**__
 __
 
• The **Nicobar Islands** are located south of the Andaman Islands in the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
• They feature lush forests and unique biodiversity but are distinct from the coral-based Lakshadweep Islands.
 
 
 
• **Sundarbans**__
 
 
• The **Sundarbans** are a mangrove forest ecosystem located in the delta region of the **Ganges, Brahmaputra, and Meghna rivers**.
 
• This region is home to the **Bengal tiger** and other endangered species.
 
• The Sundarbans are a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**, primarily comprising mangroves rather than coral islands.
